items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: And his brother, did you know his brother, Nanny Quarker? I heard his brother.

ctx.x: No, no, Phil wasn't down there. Phil from across the lake from Manerville. And his brother, did you know his brother, Nanny Quarker? I heard his brother.
He was a trumpet player. I heard his brother.
